headline: 9 Sui mainnet object/package IDs catalogued from official Buildkit docs; GitHub repo and on-chain Sui explorer data not fetched; multisig holders of admin capabilities not yet identified.

findings.text: D1: Sui's canonical explorers (suiscan.xyz, suivision.xyz) were not fetched this run — no EVM-style name-tag search API applies to Sui. Zero addresses surfaced from explorer name-tag search. Recorded in unknowns.

D2: Official deployed-contracts doc found at https://current-finance.gitbook.io/buildkit (linked from the protocol overview page). Lists Protocol Package ID, Protocol App ID, X Oracle Package ID, X Oracle Object ID, and 5 market object IDs on Sui mainnet.

D3: Audit reports page at https://current-finance.gitbook.io/current/security-and-risk/audit-reports lists 8 reports (Sherlock contest, Movebit governance, Asymptotic leverage+governance, Asymptotic lending, Pebble lending, Asymptotic formal verification, Movebit FLP, Scalebit pen-test). Files are GitBook binary blobs — not directly fetchable PDFs. No in-scope contract addresses extracted from audit PDFs this run.

D4: GitHub org is 'current-finance' per protocol.github field. Direct fetch of https://github.com/current-finance was not attempted (fetch budget exhausted). No deployment artifacts or commit SHAs retrieved this run.
D5: Protocol is single-chain (Sui only). No multi-chain enumeration required. All 9 object IDs found are on Sui mainnet.

D6: Five market object IDs surfaced from Buildkit docs (EthenaMarket, MatrixGoldMarket, AltCoinMarket, EmberMarket, MainMarket). These are child market objects, not factories in the EVM sense. Sui's object model differs — no allPools/getPool enumeration API available via the DeFiPunkd read API (which supports only EVM chainIds 1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111; Sui is not listed). Cannot call read API for Sui objects.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: Protocol Package (other), Protocol App (other), X Oracle Package (oracle), X Oracle Object (oracle), 5 Market Objects (pool). Admin capability holders (Watcher, Param-Modifier, SuperAdmin) described in docs as off-chain multisig but specific multisig addresses not yet identified.
D8: All 9 addresses in admin_addresses trace to https://current-finance.gitbook.io/buildkit fetched this run. No snippet-only sightings promoted without fetch evidence.

rationale.verdict: Walked website, audit-reports page, GitBook llms.txt index, technical-details page, security-overview page, what-is-current-finance page, code-security page, and Buildkit developer docs. Catalogued 9 Sui mainnet object/package IDs. Admin capability holders (Watcher, Param-Modifier, SuperAdmin multisig addresses) not yet identified — docs confirm capabilities exist but do not publish the holding addresses. DeFiPunkd read API does not support Sui chain. GitHub deployment artifacts not fetched. Sui block explorer not fetched. Grade is unknown as no on-chain verification was possible and admin addresses remain unidentified.

Files served as GitBook binary blobs.
Full documentation index for Current Finance GitBook; confirms existence of Buildkit docs at https://current-finance.gitbook.io/buildkit; lists all doc pages including security, governance, products.

Documents on-chain governance role table: Watcher (immediate pause/circuit-break authority), Param-Modifier (24h timelock + 12h execution window for risk-increasing actions), SuperAdmin (role membership only). States capabilities are held by an off-chain multisig. Describes outflow rate limiting, per-asset caps, Pyth oracle integration.
Confirms security framework: code security and formal verification, risk management with Allez Labs, monitoring and circuit breakers, governance and asset onboarding. Multiple audit partners named.

Describes Current Finance as a capital market for tokenized yield using isolated lending markets and flash-loan-powered looping; products are Lend, Multiply, Margin; links to Buildkit developer documentation at https://current-finance.gitbook.io/buildkit.

Lists audit firms: Asymptotics (full audit + formal verification), Movebit (governance + penetration test), Sherlock (contest audit), Asymptotic (long-term retainer for ongoing changes), Zellic (full audit). Confirms continuous code review partnership with Asymptotic.

protocol_metadata.about: Current Finance is a capital market for global tokenized real-world asset yield built on Sui, connecting yield originators with on-chain liquidity. Users can lend and borrow against RWA collateral via isolated lending markets, or use flash-loan-powered looping through the Multiply and Margin products. The protocol features a two-speed governance model where risk-reducing actions (pause, circuit-break) execute immediately via a Watcher capability, while risk-increasing parameter changes require a 24-hour timelock plus a 12-hour execution window. Price feeds are sourced exclusively from Pyth with multiple validation layers including EMA-spot divergence detection, staleness gates, and confidence-interval checks.
